children: Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ:AVGO) topped fiscal Q2 estimates and projects Q3 AI semiconductor revenue near $16B with hefty margins, while securing a $30B+ Apple deal and expanding U.S. capacity as its tech powers OpenAI’s efficient Jalapeño chip and fuels booming custom ASIC demand.
Broadcom Inc. Beats Revenue, EPS; AI 3Q Guidance
: Broadcom (AVGO) beat fiscal Q2 revenue and EPS. Management sees Q3 AI semiconductor revenue ~$16B (≈54% of $29.4B) with ~67% non-GAAP operating margin; no raise to full-year AI guide.
Broadcom Inc. Signs Apple Deal, Expands Colorado
: Broadcom (AVGO) signed a multiyear supply deal with Apple worth over $30B to deliver 15B+ U.S.-made wireless chips; Broadcom will invest $1.5B to expand its Colorado plant.
Broadcom Inc. In Jalapeño Chip Performance
: OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip, built with Broadcom Inc. (AVGO), beat Nvidia GB200/GB300 on InferenceX: 1.5–1.9x AI work per watt at peak. OpenAI plans deployment this year; mass production by 2027.
Broadcom Inc. Custom ASIC Demand Rises
: Broadcom (AVGO) sees strong demand for custom ASICs. Traders note AVGO shares rose about 0.4% after JPMorgan highlighted the company as a top pick, signaling market interest.
